## [The enumeration — what's available]

[For two parallel sets, use the two-column layout; for one set, a single run of definition rows.]

<div className="nbt-cols">
  <div className="nbt-col">
    <div className="nbt-col-label">[Set A]</div>
    <div className="nbt-col-desc">[One line on what unites this set]</div>
    <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">01</span><span className="nbt-def-term">[Item]</span><span className="nbt-def-hint">[definition or when-to-use, under ten words]</span></div>
    <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">02</span><span className="nbt-def-term">[Item]</span><span className="nbt-def-hint">[hint]</span></div>
  </div>
  <div className="nbt-col">
    <div className="nbt-col-label">[Set B]</div>
    <div className="nbt-col-desc">[One line on what unites this set]</div>
    <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">01</span><span className="nbt-def-term">[Item]</span></div>
    <div className="nbt-def"><span className="nbt-def-num">02</span><span className="nbt-def-term">[Item]</span></div>
  </div>
</div>

## [Notation or full definitions]

[When items carry precise meanings, use a table — one row per item, definition written in full sentences:]

| [Item] | [Meaning] | [Definition] |
| :----- | :-------- | :----------- |
| [x]    | [x]       | [Complete sentence.] |
| [x]    | [x]       | [Complete sentence.] |

</div>
